The m173, m61, m72, m89, m117, and m199 choices form controlled loading or loading-solvent contrasts around measured endpoint and tail anomalies. m94, m186, m195, m28, m128, m160, m211, m8, and m107 extend repair into chemically different late-retention neighborhoods. Several strong-eluent anchors prevent the batch from becoming a collection of extreme weak-eluent labels. Together these experiments cover ordinary anchors, ratio midpoints, delayed transitions, loading effects, and V1/V2 decoupling, which should improve generalization across the repeated structure-condition combinations in the Row-distribution."}
